grunt_m_1.name: Grunt
dialog: Galactic Grunt: What do you want? There's nothing to see here. The Commander's busy in the cave, so run along!

grunt_f.name: Grunt
dialog: Galactic Grunt: All that noise, all that water gone, and what's left? Magikarp. Heaps and heaps of Magikarp.
Useless things. They can't even flop in a straight line.

grunt_m_2.name: Grunt
dialog: Galactic Grunt: That's one lake done. Next stop, Lake Verity! Commander Mars will have the place to herself by now.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: A kid? Out here? Whatever you came to see, you're not going to see it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: You're too late anyway. We've got what we came for.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: The Galactic Bomb did its job, and I'll do mine. Nobody gets near the cave!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: Fine, go and look. See if the Commander is as easy as I was.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Galactic Grunt: Mind your feet! These Magikarp are everywhere. And mind me, while you're at it!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Galactic Grunt: I slipped on a Magikarp. That's the only reason you won.

magikarp_1.name: Magikarp
dialog: Magikarp splashes in a puddle no deeper than its fins.

magikarp_2.name: Magikarp
dialog: Magikarp gapes up at the sky, as if asking where its lake went.

magikarp_3.name: Magikarp
